channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: C6 Fest reúne Eduardo Leite, Giulia Be e Fernanda Paes Leme em Săo Paulo
item.description: The C6 Fest, held in São Paulo from May 21 to 24, brought together artists, influencers, and businesspeople, including Rio Grande do Sul Governor Eduardo Leite and his husband, physician Thalis Bolzan. Also in attendance were lawyer John Conor Kennedy and his wife, singer Giulia Be, as well as actress Fernanda Paes Leme. The event took place from May 21 to 24, 2026.

item.title: 6x1: Erika Hilton diz que acordo para transição foi "caminho possível"
item.description: Deputy Erika Hilton (Psol-SP) praised the transition agreement to reduce the workweek from 44h to 40h as the 'possible path', despite initially advocating for immediate reduction. She emphasized that the deal prevented opposition proposals to extend the workweek to 52h and represents a labor victory. The reduction will be gradual: 42h in the first 60 days after the PEC’s promulgation, reaching 40h within up to one year.

item.title: Sancionada lei que reconhece relevância cultural nacional da Expo Cordeiro (RJ)
item.description: Expo Cordeiro (RJ), first held in 1921, was recognized as a national cultural manifestation by Law 15.417/2026, signed by President Lula. The event, already an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Rio de Janeiro State since 2021, combines agricultural, commercial, industrial, cultural, tourism and social activities, boosting the economy of the Mountain Region.

item.title: Zanin pede vista e suspende julgamento sobre escola cívico-militar em São Paulo
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin requested a suspension (vista) and halted the judgment on the constitutionality of São Paulo's Law 1398/2024, which establishes the Civic-Military School Program. So far, only rapporteur Minister Gilmar Mendes has voted, partially accepting the PSOL and PT's claims by banning military symbols and hymns in extracurricular activities, requiring uniforms and aesthetics to reflect Brazil's cultural and religious diversity — including minorities — and ruling that payments to military police only take effect one year after the ruling's publication, emphasizing that these are civil schools where pedagogical activities must be led by teachers, not military monitors.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro aciona Janones na Justiça por fala sobre Vorcaro
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro filed a criminal complaint at the STF against federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) for slander, defamation, and insult, after he claimed she would soon be named as a beneficiary of money allegedly stolen by the Bolsonaro family from banker Daniel Vorcaro. Her lawyers argue the statement exceeds parliamentary immunity, as Michelle is not under investigation or criminal prosecution in the Master Case or related to Vorcaro’s bank, making the claim a false and harmful imputation.

item.title: Embaixada do Brasil nos EUA ignora pedido de Flávio para conceder entrevista no local
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's team confirmed that the Brazilian Embassy in the U.S. did not respond to a request to use its premises for an interview following a possible meeting with Donald Trump, prompting an alternative press briefing. The statement restricted questions to his U.S. agenda, while no meeting with Trump appeared in the president's official schedule. The trip comes amid fallout from the Daniel Vorcaro scandal and the 'Dark Horse' film controversy, which have damaged his presidential pre-campaign.

item.title: Moraes quer parecer da PGR sobre inclusão de Jair e Flávio em inquérito
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes has requested the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to issue an opinion on including former President Jair Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in an investigation into alleged obstruction of justice by Eduardo Bolsonaro. The focus is on determining whether financing for the film 'Dark Horse', funded by Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, supported Eduardo Bolsonaro's international campaign against the 2025 coup trial judgment. The PGR must respond before Moraes decides whether to expand the Federal Police's investigation, which already examines communications between Vorcaro and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Crusoé: “De vez em quando a gente elege alguém que não tem compromisso”
item.description: President Lula criticized the election of leaders lacking commitment to the common good, stating Brazil could be much better off if it didn’t elect representatives with no commitment to anything. The remark was made during a housing delivery event in Manaus, Amazonas, as part of federal efforts to improve living conditions. Lula linked governance quality to electoral choices, implying voter responsibility in selecting accountable officials.

item.title: Caiado chama Desenrola de “golpe” e acusa Lula de empobrecer o país
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Lula’s Desenrola program, calling it a 'scam' and accusing the government of encouraging public debt only to later raise interest rates, worsening financial conditions for families and businesses. He claimed these policies are impoverishing the country.

item.title: Motta afirma que aprovação da PEC 6x1 será a maior entrega da Câmara para a classe trabalhadora
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, said the approval of the PEC reducing the workweek to 40 hours and ending the 6x1 schedule will be the Chamber’s greatest delivery to the working class. He stated the vote will occur in the special committee and plenary this week, with broad political consensus, and that the 60-day transition period will not harm the economy.

item.title: Crusoé: Dino governa enquanto Lula discursa
item.description: President Lula is exclusively focused on his re-election campaign, effectively ceasing to govern the country. In speeches across Brazil, he criticizes artificial intelligence, laments femicide, condemns youth cellphone use, defends buyers of stolen phones, and delivers homes under the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program. The article implies that Justice Minister Flávio Dino is assuming governance duties while Lula campaigns.

item.title: PL confirma novos nomes para comunicação de campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PL announced changes in the communication team for Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign, confirming Eduardo Fischer as strategic consultant and Alexandre Oltramari as marketing chief, following the departure of Marcello Lopes (‘Marcelão’) amid criticism over handling the audio scandal involving funds from Banco Master. Fischer, described as Brazil’s most awarded advertiser, is expected to shape messaging to improve the candidate’s visibility and understanding among voters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro deixa hotel em Washington e diz que vai para a Casa Branca
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he is on his way to the White House after allies announced he will meet with former U.S. President Donald Trump. The comment was made on May 26, 2026, during his visit to Washington, D.C. The meeting suggests an international outreach effort by the PL’s pre-candidate for president.

item.title: Transição maior para concessionárias e exclusão dos que ganham mais viabilizaram acordo sobre 6x1 com Lula
item.description: President Lula signaled willingness to agree on reducing the 6x1 work schedule, provided there is a longer transition period for public companies and the exclusion of higher-income workers from the new labor model. This flexibility aims to secure congressional support by prioritizing stability in state-owned enterprises while protecting the earnings of already high-wage workers.

item.title: Ruptura entre Lula e Alcolumbre pode travar agenda do país, alerta Hugo Motta
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta warned that the personal rift between President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre risks paralyzing the national agenda, drawing a parallel to the Dilma Rousseff–Eduardo Cunha conflict that preceded impeachment. He said the rupture, fueled by allegations of PT interference in the Federal Police investigation against Alcolumbre, is blocking essential national dialogue, and that reconciliation does not depend on him.

item.title: Zanin interrompe julgamento sobre as escolas cívico-militares de São Paulo
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin suspended the judgment on the constitutionality of São Paulo's civic-military schools, requesting more time to study the case and now having 90 days to release the documents. Before the interruption, only rapporteur Gilmar Mendes had voted, validating the law partially as long as there is no exaltation of militarism. The trial was analyzing PSOL and PT actions arguing the law invades the Union's exclusive competence over education guidelines.

item.title: Janja amplia agenda internacional e já supera Lula em dias fora do país
item.description: First Lady Rosângela da Silva, Janja, traveled to Rome, Italy, to represent the Brazilian government at the 2026 Nutrition Week, an event promoted by the UN in partnership with UN Nutrition. The conference began on Monday, the 25th, and continues through next Thursday, reflecting an expansion in Janja’s international agenda, which has already surpassed President Lula in the number of days spent abroad.

item.title: O plano do governo para levar ajuda humanitária à Bolívia
item.description: The Brazilian government, under President Lula, has mobilized the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Defense, and the Air Force to deliver humanitarian aid to Bolivia amid a severe supply crisis and social unrest. The operation involves air transport of donated food from Brazil to La Paz, followed by an air bridge between La Paz and Santa Cruz de la Sierra. Bolivia’s crisis stems from inflation, the removal of fuel subsidies, and protests against austerity measures deemed unconstitutional by demonstrators.

item.title: Moraes envia à PGR pedido de abertura de investigação sobre ligação de Vorcaro com Eduardo e Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes has asked the PGR to respond within 5 days to a request to investigate alleged links between banker Daniel Vorcaro and the Bolsonaros (Flávio, Eduardo, and Jair) regarding financing of the film Dark Horse and Eduardo Bolsonaro's activities in the U.S. The request, filed by Congressman Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ), seeks to expand an existing case where Eduardo is accused of coercion in the coup plot trial, alleging that Vorcaro's funds may have been diverted to a Texas-based trust linked to Eduardo to sustain his stay in the U.S. after STF blocked his accounts.

item.title: Moraes manda PGR avaliar investigação contra Jair Bolsonaro no caso Dark Horse
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has given the PGR five days to respond to a request by Congressman Lindbergh Farias to investigate Jair Bolsonaro and his sons Flávio and Eduardo over the financing of the film Dark Horse by Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, allegedly negotiated by Flávio. Farias seeks to include this matter in the ongoing probe into Eduardo Bolsonaro’s activities in the U.S. to push for sanctions against Brazil, a case in which Eduardo is already a defendant.

item.title: Lula e PT desperdiçam janela de oportunidades em São Paulo e Minas
item.description: Lula and the PT are wasting time in defining their slates for São Paulo and Minas Gerais, leaving pending the choice of Haddad’s running mate and Senate candidates, despite the availability of figures like Simone Tebet, Márcio França, and Marina Silva. Internal hesitation and the lack of prior dialogue between the president and local leaders raise the risk of fragmentation of the center-left in the country’s two largest electoral colleges.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tenta derrubar post que o chama de corrupto, mas juíza nega
item.description: Judge Gabriela Jardon Guimarães de Faria of the TJ-DFT denied an urgent request by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to remove a social media post calling him 'corrupt,' stating that freedom of expression prevails even in offensive content, except in exceptional cases. The merits of the action will still be analyzed.

item.title: Governo Lula vê em viagem de Flávio aos EUA tentativa de fugir do escândalo do Master
item.description: The Lula government views Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's trip to the United States as an attempt to evade the Banco Master scandal, tied to banker Daniel Vorcaro, with whom the senator has investigated links. Although no official meeting with Donald Trump is scheduled, the Planalto Palace adopts a cautious tone due to Trump's unpredictability. Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential pre-candidate, informed the Senate he will be abroad until Thursday, March 28, maintaining regular trips to the U.S. since December 2025.

item.title: Lula diz que Brasil seria melhor sem mentiras e alerta para uso da IA
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil would be much better off if not for lies spread by politicians uncommitted to the poor, particularly during electoral campaigns. He made the remarks during the delivery of 576 housing units under the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program in Manaus, emphasizing that beneficiaries of such programs are often treated as 'invisible' by much of the political class. Lula also warned about the use of artificial intelligence to spread false information on social media, noting that while AI benefits health, education, and science, it can be dangerous in elections by amplifying lies.

item.title: Moraes ouvirá a PGR sobre incluir Jair e Flávio em inquérito contra Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has asked the Prosecutor General's Office to rule on a request to include former President Jair Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in an investigation against Eduardo Bolsonaro for alleged coercion in the coup plot. The request, submitted by federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ), is based on suspicions linking the financing of the film 'Dark Horse' — negotiated by Flávio with Daniel Vorcaro, former CEO of Banco Master — to Eduardo’s international efforts to secure sanctions against Brazilian authorities.

item.title: Moraes pede para PGR se manifestar sobre inclusão de Flávio e Jair Bolsonaro em inquérito por pedido de dinheiro para filme
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to respond within five days to a request to expand the investigation against Eduardo Bolsonaro to include Flávio and Jair Bolsonaro, alleging links between funding for the film 'Dark Horse' and Eduardo's efforts in the U.S. to pressure the STF. The request, filed by federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT), seeks sharing of evidence from Banco Master, Coaf, and international cooperation. Eduardo was previously denounced by the PGR and made a defendant for obstruction of justice related to his U.S. activities aimed at imposing sanctions on Brazilian authorities.

item.title: Moraes manda PGR se manifestar sobre pedido para incluir Bolsonaro em investigação
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has given the Prosecutor General's Office five days to respond to a request to include Flávio and Jair Bolsonaro in investigations already targeting Eduardo Bolsonaro over alleged coercion. The request was filed with the Supreme Court and now awaits the PGR's position.

item.title: Do ‘caos completo’ à mudança de eixo: as verdadeiras intenções de Flávio com Trump
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro traveled to the United States to shift public attention away from the Banco Master scandal, which caused a drop in his polling numbers following leaked audio recordings. Allies claim the trip was initiated by a White House invitation, and a potential meeting with Donald Trump aims to reposition his presidential pre-campaign by focusing on foreign policy and Trumpist alignment rather than allegations tied to Daniel Vorcaro. Despite this strategy, the political crisis within Bolsonaro’s circle remains intense, particularly after comments by PL president Valdemar Costa Neto reignited controversy over Flávio’s continued contact with Vorcaro under electronic monitoring.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Trump vai dar um cano em Flávio?
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program discussed the possible meeting between Flávio Bolsonaro and Donald Trump in the U.S., as well as Valdemar Costa Neto's controversial statements about Flávio. It also covered the progress of the PEC ending the 6×1 work regime.

item.title: Crusoé: Todos querem uma foto com Trump
item.description: Although foreign policy is rarely a central theme in Brazilian presidential campaigns, two pre-candidates have sought photos with U.S. President Donald Trump to gain visibility and political capital. The article frames this gesture as an attempt to secure international legitimacy amid domestic preoccupations with corruption, violence, and institutional distrust.

item.title: Lula diz ter feito acordo com Motta por PEC do fim da escala 6x1, que pretende usar como bandeira eleitoral
item.description: President Lula announced an agreement with Chamber President Hugo Motta to approve the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing weekly hours from 44 to 40 with two days off, while maintaining current salaries. The change will be implemented within up to one year and is intended to be a key electoral banner for the PT in 2026, emphasizing its impact on women's double shift.

item.title: 85% dizem que seriam afetados por alta de preços com fim da 6 X 1
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows 85% of Brazilians believe they would be affected by a potential price increase if the 6x1 work scale is ended, with 64 percentage points saying they would be 'very affected' and 21 points 'a little affected.' Although 63% say they would benefit from the change, support for ending the scale has dropped from 71% in March to 65%, and supporter engagement remains low, with small demonstrations. The constitutional amendment proposal is being debated in the Chamber of Deputies with only two months of discussion and significant imbalance in sector hearings.

item.title: Virando a casaca: Soraya Thronicke diz por que ficou de ‘queixo caído’ com Lula
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) announced her support for President Lula's re-election, praising his humanity and criticizing the Bolsonaro government for causing four months of destruction that takes years to repair. She stated she changed sides due to having no fixed political commitments, citing her participation in parliamentary inquiries where only Lula supporters appeared, and is now running for re-election in Mato Grosso do Sul as part of Lula's ticket.

item.title: Crusoé: O que vai sobrar do Novo depois de Zema
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for his conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro, exposing internal tensions within the Novo party. Zema, who brought Novo closer to Bolsonarism after his election as governor of Minas Gerais in 2018, now faces an existential challenge by questioning alliances that helped define the party’s recent identity. These divisions threaten Novo’s ideological future as it approaches the 2026 elections.

item.title: Leia a decisão de Mendonça que autorizou operação contra Cláudio Castro
item.description: Justice André Mendonça of the STF authorized the 8th phase of Operation Compliance Zero, launched by the Federal Police on May 26, 2026. The operation investigates alleged financial crimes involving Rio de Janeiro’s public servants’ pension fund (Rioprevidência) and Banco Master, with former governor Cláudio Castro (PL) among the targets. The decision was based on PF requests and aims to uncover misappropriation of public funds.

item.title: Lula x BC: estímulos derrubam esforço de controle da economia
item.description: Despite high interest rates maintained by the Central Bank to control inflation, the Lula government has adopted economic stimulus measures to sustain popular support. This strategy creates tension between the executive and monetary authorities, as stimulus may undermine efforts to cool the economy. Bloomberg notes the government prioritizes political backing over fiscal and monetary discipline.

item.title: Governo Lula regulamenta subsídio de R$ 0,44 à gasolina
item.description: President Lula’s government regulated a R$0.44 per liter gasoline subsidy for two months, paid directly to producers and importers via ANP, to counter fuel price impacts from the Middle East war. The decree also renewed the diesel subsidy at R$0.35 per liter, maintaining federal tax exemptions since the conflict began. The measure functions as a cashback of previously collected taxes and requires companies to register via adhesion term.

item.title: PF deve apurar suspeita de cobrança na casa de Vorcaro por Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT has asked the Federal Police to investigate whether Flávio Bolsonaro requested money from Daniel Vorcaro during a visit to the banker's home, allegedly to fund the film 'Dark Horse'. Valdemar Costa Neto confirmed the visit, stating it was normal and related to fundraising for the project. The PF must verify the truth of the statements within ongoing investigations into Vorcaro's associates.

item.title: Sancionada lei que cria Rota Turística da Serra da Capivara, no Piauí
item.description: The sanctioned law establishes the Serra da Capivara Tourist Route in Piauí, aiming to boost tourism, preserve archaeological heritage, and integrate local municipalities into federal tourism support programs. The law includes cities such as São Raimundo Nonato, João Costa, Brejo do Piauí, Coronel José Dias, and São João, and automatically incorporates future municipalities formed from dismemberment or merger. It highlights the region’s over 300 archaeological sites, including rock art up to 50,000 years old, recognized by UNESCO as a World Cultural Heritage site.

item.title: Por que o namoro entre investidores estrangeiros e o Brasil esfriou, de acordo com gestores
item.description: Brazil’s market rally stalled after April, with the Ibovespa down 11% from its peak and foreign investors withdrawing R$10 billion in May, reversing a decade-long positive capital inflow. Although the 'Vorcaro day' audio leak triggered short-term exchange rate volatility, fund managers say the shift is driven by global factors — including persistent inflation, high interest rates abroad, and the unresolved Iran conflict — not by local electoral developments.

item.title: MP libera R$ 30 bilhões para compra de táxis e carros de aplicativos
item.description: The federal government has issued a provisional measure allocating R$30 billion to finance sustainable vehicles (electric, ethanol-hybrid, or flex) for taxi drivers, app-based drivers, and cooperatives, with favorable credit terms and special benefits for women. Eligibility requires at least 12 months of active registration and 100 completed trips on the same platform. Applications are submitted via gov.br/movebrasil, with responses within five business days and credit access starting June 19, processed through authorized financial institutions.

item.title: Aliados veem candidatura de Castro ao Senado como inviável após nova operação da PF, e PL aguarda Flávio para discutir substituto
item.description: PL allies assess that Cláudio Castro’s 2026 Senate candidacy is becoming politically unviable following a new PF operation targeting alleged irregularities in R$3 billion in Rioprevidência investments linked to Banco Master. The cascade of investigations—including his TSE ineligibility ruling and the Refit operation—has intensified internal discomfort, with party leaders viewing his continued presence on the ticket as a legal and political risk for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign. Federal deputy Carlos Jordy (PL-RJ) is emerging as the favored replacement, awaiting Flávio’s return from the U.S. to finalize the ticket.

item.title: 'Estou para conhecer sujeito mais baixo', diz Carlos Bolsonaro sobre novas críticas de Zema a Flávio
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro called Romeu Zema a 'lowly individual' after the former Minas Gerais governor renewed criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro. Zema claimed voting for Flávio would likely hand the election to the left and Lula, citing polls showing the PT candidate ahead. The conflict reflects growing rifts between the Novo party and the Bolsonaro family ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula autoriza ajuda humanitária para a Bolívia; entenda a crise política no país
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva authorized humanitarian aid to Bolivia, which is facing protests against President Rodrigo Paz, leading to shortages of food, fuel, and medicine. Lula emphasized dialogue and respect for democratic institutions, while the U.S., Argentina, and Colombia also offered assistance, with the U.S. State Department labeling the situation a humanitarian crisis and the protests as efforts to destabilize the democratically elected government.

item.title: Eleições legislativas nos EUA podem impor dura derrota a Trump
item.description: The 2024 U.S. legislative elections on November 3 could significantly diminish Donald Trump’s political power if Democrats gain control of the House and/or Senate. Experts estimate a 90% chance of Democrats retaking the House, which would constrain his agenda and increase risks of impeachment or legislative obstruction. A growing wave of public disapproval — fueled by controversial foreign policy like the Iran strike — has pushed Trump’s disapproval rate above 56%, harming Republican candidates’ prospects.

item.title: A arriscada estratégia de Flávio Bolsonaro ao tentar encontro com Trump nos EUA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is seeking a meeting with Donald Trump in the U.S. to mitigate the fallout from a controversy involving a money request to Daniel Vorcaro. The strategy is seen as risky, relying on Trump’s willingness to meet and the ability of Bolsonaro-aligned allies in the U.S. government to fit him into the agenda. So far, the plan has only intensified pressure on the PL presidential hopeful.

item.title: Empresários se reúnem com Alcolumbre para atrasar fim da 6 X 1
item.description: Business leaders, led by Paulo Skaf of Fiesp, met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to delay the reduction of the workweek from 44 to 40 hours, known as ending the 6X1 schedule. The group aims to block the proposal, which has already been advanced by a gradual transition plan from federal deputy Leo Prates (Republicanos-BA), with two phases of two-hour cuts over 14 months. Despite an agreement between Lula and House Speaker Hugo Motta to implement the change within 14 months, the productive sector warns of potential economic harm.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei sobre prazo para salário-maternidade
item.description: President Lula signed Law 15.415/2026, establishing a maximum 30-day deadline for the granting of maternity salary paid directly by the Social Security system, starting from the administrative request. If the deadline is not met, the benefit is granted provisionally and automatically, with no requirement to repay the amounts received, except in cases of proven bad faith. The law amends Law 8.213/1991 and took effect upon publication in the Official Gazette.

item.title: Nós contra eles’
item.description: Lula plans to radicalize his agenda to the left in a potential fourth term, leveraging Flávio Bolsonaro's declining poll numbers to intensify a 'us versus them' rhetoric, focusing on policies like income tax exemptions for those earning up to R$5,000 and attacks on 'bankers and millionaires'. Although he presented himself as a moderate during the campaign to attract non-PT voters, reports suggest his true aim is to leave a mark with more ambitious left-wing policies. The article is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Por que Lula ou Flávio Bolsonaro podem vencer no 1º turno, segundo especialista em pesquisas
item.description: Specialist Maurício Moura argues that Brazil's 2026 presidential election could be decided in the first round, with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro as the main contenders. He states that if current polling trends hold — both candidates above 30% — there is a strong likelihood of a first-round victory on October 4, a feat not seen since 1998. The outcome will hinge on whether voters believe Lula deserves re-election and on voter turnout.
